name: Vanilla Draft Latte
summary: Vanilla version of the Draft Latte. The 2026 reformulation cut sugar to 15 g, less than half of a typical flavored dairy coffee.
tastingNotes: Vanilla is the flavor every coffee company makes, which means it's the one where you find out whether they can actually make coffee. There's nothing to hide behind. Thin coffee and fake-tasting milk show up immediately in a vanilla. I cracked this one open cold, straight out of the fridge. The can promises frothy and creamy, which is marketing copy, so I didn't expect it to hold up. It does. You get real foam when you pour it, and it sits there for a minute instead of collapsing into brown milk. The vanilla is soft and stays in the background. What you taste first is coffee, then milk, and the sweetness turns up last instead of leading. There's 190 mg of caffeine in this 11 ounce can, which is more than I expected from something that goes down this easy. It does not taste like a drink that's about to do that to you. I had the Pumpkin Spice two weeks earlier. The pumpkin is dessert. This one is coffee that tastes good, and it's the one I'd keep in the fridge. It's still sweet, so if you drink your coffee black it won't convert you. I'd buy it again, and when I do I'll buy the twelve pack.
